Cockroach Janta Party Leaders Meet BJP President Nadda

Leaders from the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) met with Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) President JP Nadda. Following the meeting, CJP representatives stated that Nadda listened to their concerns with empathy. The CJP had previously claimed that the government had reached out to them, and their representatives were on their way to meet Nadda.
